title: Poor quality replacement left black charcoal like substance everywhere
text: Poor quality replacement left black charcoal like substance everywhere. We have ordered this item from this seller several time before. This time product received was different and of poor quality. Immediately black dust fell out upon opening the platic film of package. The feel of the filter material is thinner and our home floor is now covered with this black dust. Wiped floor four times and residue is still left on our hardwood flooring. Also ended up with this black dust on our clothing. We will not buy this item again from this sell.

product_metadata.title: Honeywell C-6005 38002 Enviracare Universal Replacement Pre-Filter
features: UNIVERSAL PRE-FILTER: This replacement pre-filter for Honeywell HEPA air purifier models fits most Honeywell Round, QuietCare, & SilentComfort Series models. For best results replace every 3 months.
TRAP DIRT & REDUCE ODORS: This pre-filter traps more dirt than standard carbon filters & helps reduce common household odors. It can be cut to fit to make 1 to 3 pre-filters, depending on your model.
FILTER & CIRCULATE: Honeywell Air Purifiers filter & circulate air in the stated room size up to 5 times an hour. Breathe easy knowing the air in your home is fresher & cleaner with fewer allergens.
HONEYWELL QUALITY REPLACEMENT FILTERS: For best performance use only genuine Honeywell Replacement filters. Each air purifier's performance is tested as a system with the filters for best efficiency.
HONEYWELL QUALITY: Improve your air quality & neutralize odors for a clean & healthy breathing experience year round with Honeywell replacement filters for air cleaners, purifiers & humidifiers.
